versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.5

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

Initial release of cn-unit-converter:

- Supports conversion for seven categories: length, weight, temperature, capacity, area, data, and time.
- Works with common units such as km/mi, kg/lb, C/F/K, L/gal, ㎡/sqft, GB/MB, and hour/min.
- Pure Python implementation; no external dependencies or API keys required.
- Simple command-line usage: python3 scripts/unit_converter.py <value> <from_unit> <to_unit>.
- Includes usage examples and covers both metric and imperial units.
